text:
Amanda Li: Hey, heads up — we've got a repeating oscillation in routing for tenant `acme-inc` in eu-west-2. Traffic flips between dedicated slice and shared routing every ~20–40s. Latency spikes ~200–400ms when it flips. Any ideas?

Raj Patel: Ugh. Saw similar last week but not as periodic. Can you paste a short trace? :thinking:

Amanda Li: Here's a snippet from the router logs and a tail of the proxy metrics:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:02Z router: route_change tenant=acme-inc from=dedicated->shared weight=0.48
2026-03-18T14:12:22Z router: route_change tenant=acme-inc from=shared->dedicated weight=0.62
proxy: kvcache_miss tenant=acme-inc key=prefix_abc slow_path=1
proxy: latency p95=420ms p50=120ms
```

Jia Chen: Looks like kvcache warmup failing when it lands on shared nodes -> higher tail -> router backs off and flips back. Could be eviction pressure on shared pools.

Tom Nguyen: Can we clamp routing weight delta or introduce a cooldown so we don't flip so fast? Also consider sticky routes for sticky sessions.

Raj Patel: Agree on cooldown. Proposal: enforce min_stay=60s on route decisions for tenants with p95 > 200ms, and cap weight swing to +/-0.15 per decision.

Amanda Li: That should stop the oscillation while we root-cause cache pressure. Do we have an easy knob? Where does that live? 

Tom Nguyen: Router config lives in `routing-service` -> `policy.rs`. I can add a clamp and a `decision_cooldown` flag. Quick patch should be straightforward.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4123: `egress-oscillation-kvcache-clamp-probe` and assigned to Tom Nguyen.

Tom Nguyen: I'll open a small PR to introduce `decision_cooldown=60s` and `max_weight_delta=0.15`. Will instrument with a gauge. ETA 90m.

Jia Chen: Meanwhile I'll try soft-pinning top prefixes in the shared pool for `acme-inc` for 30 minutes to give the cache time to warm. If we still see misses we can reserve 1GB for them.

Raj Patel: Also can we add an egress hedging cooldown so egress credits don't get burned by rapid failovers? Something like prevent draining dedicated pool for 2m after failover.

Amanda Li: Good call. Can we also enable a temporary prober that runs a synthetic warmup sequence after any route flip? 5 warmup calls to prime kv cache.

Tom Nguyen: I'll include the prober hook in the PR, gated behind a feature flag `route_warmup_probe`.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor acme-inc latency dashboard and set an alert for repeated flips >3 within 5m.

Amanda Li: Thanks everyone. Owning actions:
- Tom: PR for clamp + probe + cooldown (PR link when up)
- Jia: soft-pinning and possible reserve
- Raj: egress-credit cooldown proposal
- SRE: alert config

Amanda Li: If the PR helps we can roll to eu-west-2 canary and then the fleet. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy request created -> env=staging service=routing-service tag=pr/567 note="decision_cooldown feature-flag"

Raj Patel: Nice. Ping here when staging pass. If we still see oscillation after clamp, we may need to give `acme-inc` a short dedicated warm slice until kvcache reliability improves.

Amanda Li: Will do. Thanks all.
